findings.title: New generation helper omits required type hints
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-12 says: "Python functions must carry type hints on parameters and return values". `_do_generate` leaves `set_status` untyped and has no return annotation. The diff adds this helper; verified its signature with `git show HEAD:src-tauri/sidecar/server.py | nl -ba | sed -n '285,305p'`. Add the missing parameter and return annotations to meet the documented Python rule.

findings.title: YouTube extraction fails once the sidecar response takes over 30 seconds
findings.description: The shared reqwest 0.12 client keeps its default 30-second request timeout, while the new outer timeout cannot extend that client limit. The YouTube endpoint waits for yt-dlp to finish before returning, and its caller now asks to allow 180 seconds; a download taking 30–180 seconds therefore fails at the client's default timeout (the prior per-call client was configured for 180 seconds).

findings.title: New audio command has no test of its behavior
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-16 says: "Every new public function, command, or component with logic must have a test in the same change; a bug fix must add a test that fails before the fix." The new command validates the id, fetches the sidecar response, handles HTTP errors, and returns audio bytes, but the added Rust tests cover only `validate_generation_id`; `voicebox.test.ts` mocks the Tauri invoke and only tests the frontend wrapper. No test exercises this command's behavior. Verified with `git grep -n -E 'get_generation_audio|validate_generation_id' HEAD --` and the Rust test block at lines 870-889. Add a test for the command's sidecar response and error handling.

findings.title: Revoke generated audio URLs when the wizard releases them
findings.description: Each call allocates a Blob URL that remains live until URL.revokeObjectURL is called or the document unloads. The create-voice route revokes it when another generation starts, but its Upload Another Sample action clears the URL without revoking it, and route navigation can leave the document alive; repeated test generations therefore retain the full audio blobs for the session. Revoke the URL whenever the route drops it and on route teardown.
